system.description: A rune-covered tracking dart paired with a ring; within a kilometre or two the ring pulses toward the dart. If the dart hits a target in combat and stays lodged (removing it takes a half action), the ring's wearer ignores penalties for being unable to see that target, such as darkness or smoke.
system.effectText: Tracking dart with paired ring; if lodged, ring wearer ignores sight penalties against that target.
